description: Season-peak models on the ILI-converted seasons (2026-10-12): admissions-only 36-week sampled MLPs (the NHSN tree's best single recipe with square-root counts and local noise, and its fourth-root root R), trained and evaluated leave-one-season-out over the 10 ILI-converted seasons 2011-12..2021-22 (2020-21 excluded) on problem us-flu-long-horizon-ili; peaks scored with chromantis.seasonal on us-flu-season-peak-ili against climatology and analogue baselines.
